title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Ramp Metering Based on Traffic Video Data

method_nodes.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator
method_nodes.description: Simulation of a freeway segment connecting Qingdao and Huangdao with a one-lane on-ramp and three-lane mainline using real-world traffic volumes.

method_nodes.source_quote: Vehicle locations from raw images are extracted to reconstruct visual representations in the DRL method
method_nodes.description: Extraction of vehicle positions (xi, yi) and signal states into a position matrix mt. Consecutive N matrices are stacked and down-sampled to form the state st.

method_nodes.source_quote: The Q-network in Mnih et al. [30] is revised as Figure 7, which consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer
method_nodes.description: A multitask DRL architecture with three CNN layers and two parallel FC heads: one for Q-value estimation and one for predicting speed and queue length.

method_nodes.source_quote: The experience replay [30] stores the data prepared for training into the replay buffer and samples these data uniformly for training the agent.
method_nodes.description: Training using the Adam optimizer and epsilon-greedy strategy. A target network is used for stability, updated every F intervals. Loss includes Q-learning and multitask prediction errors.

method_nodes.source_quote: The proposed DRL method results in (1) lower travel times in the mainline, (2) shorter vehicle queues at the on-ramp
method_nodes.description: Evaluation of the trained policy across 20 simulation experiments. Comparison against 'no control' and 'PI-ALINEA' baselines using travel time, speed, and queue metrics.

method_nodes.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data.
method_nodes.description: The control area is divided into eight subareas. Information from specific subareas is removed to test the sensitivity of the DRL controller to spatial data.

source_nodes.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
source_nodes.description: Traffic volume data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation parameters in SUMO for a real-world case study.
